practicals.title: Example 1
content: Measure distance between two intervisible stations using chain, tape
and ranging rods

practicals.title: Example 2
content: Perform reciprocal ranging and measure distance between two
stations on uneven ground

practicals.title: Example 3
content: Determine area of open field using chain and cross staff survey
method

practicals.title: Example 4
content: Measure fore bearing and back bearing of survey lines of open
traverse using Prismatic Compass

practicals.title: Example 5
content: Measure and correct fore bearing and back bearing of closed
traverse (3–4 sides) for local attraction and included angles

practicals.title: Example 6
content: Conduct chain and compass survey project for closed traverse with
minimum five stations and plotting

practicals.title: Example 7
content: Perform simple leveling using Dumpy Level / Auto Level and
leveling staff

practicals.title: Example 8
content: Perform differential leveling and determine reduced levels using HI
method and rise & fall method

practicals.title: Example 9
content: Conduct fly leveling with double check using dumpy level/auto
level and leveling staff

practicals.title: Example10
content: Conduct survey project for contour mapping using block contouring
method (100 m × 100 m area with 10 m grid)

practicals.title: Example 11
content: Plot contours on A1 size drawing sheet using collected survey data

practicals.title: Example 12
content: Demonstrate use of Global Positioning System (GPS) in surveying
applications

practicals.title: Example 13
content: Solve numerical problems on chain surveying including correction
of chain length and area calculation

practicals.title: Example 14
content: Solve numerical problems on compass surveying and leveling
including bearings, included angles, HI method and rise & fall
method
Total Hours 56
